text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
This one is headed "Transcribed from the singing of the Hampton Institute students": the four parts were written down as the students sang them, and filed among the "Hymns of Consolation".

source.en: R. Nathaniel Dett, ed., Religious Folk-Songs of the Negro as Sung at Hampton Institute (1927), p. 88, read from the scan

Hampton's songbook was first published in 1874, when its student singers were giving concerts in the North to raise the walls of Virginia Hall.

source.en: R. Nathaniel Dett, ed., Religious Folk-Songs of the Negro as Sung at Hampton Institute (1927), reprinting the preface to the edition of 1891, p. vii
